findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "audit_x402_and_a2a_endpoint" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "x402 V2, MCP & A2A Protocol Compliance Auditor (0.01 USDC via x402): Audits any URL for HTTP 402 x402 V2 compliance, PAYMENT-REQUIRED headers, Bazaar schema, and MCP." → after: "A2A, MCP & HTTP 402 Endpoint SLA Compliance Auditor (0.01 USDC via x402): Audits any remote agent or MCP URL for JSON-RPC compliance, latency SLA, OpenAPI schema, and HTTP 402 settlement headers."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
